# FCIGenerateSMA

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FCI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FCI/FCIGenerateSMA`

```text
FCIGenerateSMA, version 0.01

Usage: FCIGenerateSMA [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --eigenstate-file : name of the vector file to which the SMA should be applied
    --degenerate-groundstate : name of the file that gives the vector files to which the SMA should be applied (in all-bilinear or sma mode)
    --only-kx : only evalute a given x momentum sector (negative if all kx sectors have to be computed) (default value = -1)
    --only-ky : only evalute a given y momentum sector (negative if all ky sectors have to be computed) (default value = -1)
    --only-gx : only evalute a given x momentum sector (negative if only the first Brillouin zone has to be computed) (default value = 0)
    --only-gy : only evalute a given y momentum sector (negative if only the first Brillouin zone has to be computed) (default value = 0)
    --all-bilinear : apply all bilinear operators to the ground state, without summing on the sector
    --compute-allsma : compute all SMA
    --quantum-distance : include the quantum distance when computing the SMA
    --import-onebody : import information on the tight binding model from a binary file
    --embedding-file : import embedding information from a text file (override information from onebody file)

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

precalculation options:

tools options:

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
